A distinct CAS owner anchored by ICSC with asymmetric parent mapping completes the work; anhydrous, dihydrate and pentahemihydrate forms remain distinct.

Owner CAS6106-04-3 derives from automated name lookup, not a JCM904 supplier record. The historical recommendation is preserved but does not override unresolved source senses.
